items.question: Where must the kṣa-syllable joined with bindu be placed within the ritual diagram?
premises: The kṣa-syllable is specified as joined with bindu.
The petals are designated as placement locations.

items.inference: The kṣa-syllable joined with bindu is to be placed in the petals and in the interior of the pericarp.
